title: The Known World
summary: An overview of the lands, kingdoms, and territories known to the peoples of the world.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: This article is a starting point for documenting the world's geography. Replace this placeholder with the campaign's established lore.
Use the links throughout the archive to connect places with the people, factions, and historical events associated with them.

sections.heading: Regions
paragraphs: No regions have been formally documented yet. Add each kingdom, province, wilderness, and significant landmark as its own article.

title: The Divine Order
summary: A directory for the gods, divine offices, religions, and competing claims to divinity.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: This entry is a public-facing placeholder. Add only information that characters in the world could reasonably know.
Individual deities should receive their own articles, with links to their worshippers, symbols, domains, and associated historical events.

sections.heading: Divine succession
paragraphs: The question of whether a god can be replaced, overthrown, or destroyed belongs among the central theological and political questions of the setting.

title: The First Deicide
summary: A historical entry documenting the first known killing of a deity. Its truth and consequences remain to be established.

sections.heading: Historical record
paragraphs: This is a campaign placeholder, not established canon. Decide who recorded the event, which sources survive, and whether competing accounts exist.

sections.heading: Legacy
paragraphs: A deicide can reshape religion, law, political legitimacy, and the balance of supernatural power. Record the consequences that are publicly understood separately from hidden truths.
